name: anderson
description: Gated maker/checker pipeline: plan (opus/medium) -> grill (you harden it) -> plan-review -> [human] -> implement (sonnet/medium) -> diff-review (read-only) -> [human], then ship (commit + PR). Reviews are tiered off the plan Scorecard: trivial skips the diff review, hard runs it on fable/high, critical runs both reviews on fable/high. Self-contained agents; no external skills required. Big tasks are sized by tokens and built in slices stacked on one branch and one PR, with contracts between slices.
